about: VRG Jegyzetek (the central Notes app): its modules, the versions (profiles) a user picks in ⚙ → Változat, and the origins (every app that writes notes into it). Data only; one source for the phone (VRG Mobile feature-notes, copied into the APK) and the later Desktop page. Contract: Notes/README.md. Validate: node Notes/tools/check.js
